$comment: What CI does with each example, and the only place that says it. scripts/serve-and-assert.mjs is the single reader of `build`, `start`, `port` and `assertRender`; every workflow in .github/workflows calls it with a directory name and keeps no copy of any of this. Edit an entry here and CI follows. `buildOnly` is a debt marker, not a category - the script skips such an example and prints `buildOnlyReason`, every example is meant to end up asserted, and the marker names what has to happen for it to go away.
